# Emerald

Emerald applies a green and emerald color scheme built for the Obsidian dark mode, styling the editor, side panes and interface controls with consistent accents and contrast intended to help readability. The theme index records dark mode only and marks the entry as legacy.

![Emerald screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-emerald/HEAD/example.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Emerald"
    author: "gracejoseph1236"
    repo:   "gracejoseph1236/obsidian-emerald"
    slug:   "emerald"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/emerald"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-emerald"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-emerald/HEAD/example.png"

    modes:  ["dark"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a green/emerald color scheme optimized for Obsidian's dark mode. Style the editor, side panes, and UI controls with consistent emerald accents and clear contrast for improved readability."
}
```
